features.name: Minimal repository harness and visual workflow acceptance
features.description: Add persistent task state, read-only Windows verification, and session lifecycle rules. Require visual form-based acceptance of affected state transitions and reversal cycles for future behavior changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Startup routes to state and read-only verification; completion and session closure require recorded evidence.
The verifier checks state, dependencies, completion evidence, visual scenario gates, and relative documentation links without building, launching, or accessing a database.
Behavior acceptance prioritizes real desktop form flows, allowed and blocked transitions, reversals, repeated cycles, and persisted readback; missing visual evidence blocks completion.
Checks and limitations are recorded; application files and preexisting local files are preserved.

features.evidence: 2026-10-03: init.ps1 passed state/completion checks, 159 relative file links, and git diff --check. Fourteen isolated negative checks rejected invalid state/dependencies/scope and unsupported completion claims without changing repository harness hashes. Structural audit improved from 36 to 84/100. Source/content/diff review confirmed the six-file authorized scope and visual acceptance policy. See progress.md for commands, boundaries, and next action. No application build, launch, or database exercise was performed.
